name: Epic Ocean Adventures
summary: A small family-run eco tour company in Noosa Heads, running tours since 2011. Most trips go by 4x4 along the beach to Double Island Point in the Great Sandy National Park for ocean kayaking with dolphins and whales, surf lessons and beach days. Shorter kayak and paddleboard tours explore the mangrove creeks of Noosa Heads.
standouts: Recognised as a 2024 Best of Queensland Experience
Paddle-powered wildlife tours with no engines ("Paddles up, engines off")

contact.address: Mobile tour operator, Noosa Heads QLD 4567

trips.title: Noosa Dolphin Tours - Epic Ocean Kayak Tour
trips.summary: A guided ocean kayak tour at Double Island Point, reached by 4x4 along Teewah Beach from Noosa. You paddle the sheltered bay looking for bottlenose dolphins, turtles and rays, with humpback whales from June to October. No kayaking experience is needed.
highlights: 4x4 beach drive from Noosa via the Tewantin cable ferry
Bottlenose dolphins seen all year, whales June to October
Kayaking portion is typically around 2 hours
Six pick up points around Noosa
trips.departsFrom: Pick up points in Noosa: The J Noosa (60 Noosa Drive, Noosa Heads), Noosa Heads Bus Station, Bounce Noosa, 12 Robert St Noosaville (Coral Beach Resort), Noosa North Shore Ferries (Tewantin), or Noosa North Shore accommodation

prices.label: Per person
prices.note: Shown as "Price $172" on the tour page. The FAQ says there are no child discounts on Double Island Point tours.

trips.requirements: No kayaking experience needed. Maximum weight 110kg per participant for sea kayaking (FAQ). Tell the team when booking if a child is under 7 so a car seat can be arranged.
trips.checkNotes: Price conflict: the tour page shows $172 but the Noosa Kayaking Tours listing page shows $166 for the Dolphin Sea Kayak Tour. Used the tour page. Departure times vary daily around low tide and are only shown in the booking calendar. The FAQ page lists a slightly different set of pick up points from the tour page.

trips.title: Noosa Whale Watching Ocean Kayaking
trips.summary: A guided whale watching tour by sea kayak at Double Island Point, run in the June to October humpback migration. The day starts with a 4x4 beach drive from Noosa, then a beginner-friendly paddle in the protected bay with no engine noise. Dolphins, turtles and rays are also often seen.
highlights: Runs June to October during the humpback migration
Paddle-powered, no engine noise near the whales
4x4 beach drive from Noosa included
Free time to swim at Double Island Point
trips.departsFrom: Pick up points in Noosa: The J Noosa Theatre, Noosa Heads Bus Station, Bounce Noosa, Coral Beach Resort Noosa, Noosa North Shore Ferries, Noosa North Shore

prices.label: Per person
prices.note: Shown as "Price $176" on the tour page and the listing page. The FAQ says there are no child discounts on Double Island Point tours.

trips.requirements: Beginner-friendly. Maximum weight 110kg per participant for sea kayaking (FAQ). Tell the team when booking if a child is under 7 so a car seat can be arranged.
trips.checkNotes: Departure times vary daily around low tide and are only shown in the booking calendar. The page states whale sightings are not guaranteed.

trips.title: Noosa Private 4×4 Day Tour
trips.summary: A private day trip from Noosa to Double Island Point with your own guide and a 4x4 towing a trailer of kayaks, paddleboards, surfboards, snorkel gear and bodyboards. The day is planned around your group, with one or two water activities, a picnic lunch and a shade cabana on the beach. Pick up is from your Noosa accommodation.
highlights: Private guide and 4x4 vehicle for your group
Choice of 1 or 2 aquatic activities
Picnic lunch, drinks and CoolCabana shade
Pick up from Noosa accommodation
trips.departsFrom: Pick up from accommodation in the Noosa region

prices.label: Private tour
prices.note: Shown as "From $1,390" on the Noosa Kayaking Tours listing page. The private tour page itself shows no price and says to use the booking form. The site does not say how many people this covers.

includes: Pick up and drop off from Noosa accommodation
trips.checkNotes: Duration is "6-7 Hours" on the tour page, "7 Hours" on the listing page and "Typically we take 7 hours" in the FAQ, so durationMinutes is left null. Price comes only from the listing page. Departure time is custom. The menu also calls this "Epic Private Tour - Double Island Point".

trips.title: Noosa Heads: Hidden Waterways & Wildlife Kayak Tour
trips.summary: A 2 hour kayak tour on the calm, sheltered creeks of Weyba Creek Conservation Park in Noosa Heads. You paddle through mangrove tunnels and past stingray areas, with plenty of birdlife. Choose self guided with a map and briefing, or fully guided, and there is a scavenger hunt for kids.
highlights: Mangrove tunnels and stingray sanctuaries
Inside the Noosa Biosphere Reserve
Self guided or fully guided options
Free all day parking at the meeting point
trips.departsFrom: Canoe Launch, Weyba Esplanade, Noosa Heads

prices.label: Fully Guided
prices.note: Per person ($99pp). Other bookings may join the group.

includes: Self guided or fully guided kayak tour
trips.checkNotes: A private option is mentioned but no private price is shown. The FAQ says Noosa River tours have lower prices for children, but no child price appears on the page. The menu calls this "Stingray & Mangrove Tunnel Kayak Tour". Departure times are only in the booking calendar.

trips.title: Noosa Stand Up Paddle - Mangrove Tunnel & Stingray Tour
trips.summary: A 2 hour stand up paddleboard tour through the mangrove tunnels and quiet creeks of Noosa Heads. It starts with a short lesson on the water, then a paddle past birdlife and stingrays, with an optional swim stop. Self guided, fully guided and private options are offered.
highlights: Introductory SUP lesson at the start
Calm, shallow, protected water
Hidden mangrove tunnel
Optional swim stop
trips.departsFrom: Canoe Launch, Weyba Esplanade, Noosa Heads (pick up from Bounce Noosa or The J Theatre on request)

prices.label: Fully Guided
prices.note: Per person ($99pp). Other bookings may join the group.

includes: Self guided, fully guided or private stand up paddle experience
trips.requirements: Suitable for all skill levels, including beginners.
trips.checkNotes: Departure times vary daily around high tide and are only in the booking calendar. No private price shown. The SUP listing page also shows "$59" for this tour.

trips.title: Eco SUP Day Tour @ Double Island Point
trips.summary: A stand up paddleboard day trip that pairs a 4x4 beach drive through the Great Sandy National Park with a paddle in the waist-deep lagoon at Double Island Point. The flat water suits all skill levels, and turtles and rays are often seen. Wetsuits are provided in the colder months.
highlights: 4x4 drive past the Rainbow Beach coloured sands
Paddle in a waist-deep lagoon
Ferry and National Park entry fees included
Wetsuits provided in colder months
trips.departsFrom: Pick up points: Noosa North Shore Ferries (Tewantin), The J Noosa (60 Noosa Drive, Noosa Heads), Noosa Heads Bus Station, 12 Robert St Noosaville (Coral Beach Resort), or Noosa North Shore accommodation

prices.label: Per person
prices.note: Shown as "Price $166" on the Noosa Stand Up Paddle Tours page.

trips.checkNotes: This tour has no page of its own and is not in the site menu. Its Book Now button jumps to an embedded Rezdy catalog (98077, stand up paddle tours), so the booking link is that catalog, not a single product. The same block also says to start a booking to see the price, next to the shown $166. Check it is still sold.

trips.title: Learn To Surf Safari & Beach 4×4 Tour
trips.summary: A small group surf lesson at Double Island Point, a long sandy point break reached by 4x4 along the beach from Noosa. Instructors start on the sand with safety and technique, then coach you in waist-deep water for about 2 hours. It suits first-timers, kids and intermediate surfers.
highlights: Lessons on a long sandy point break
About 2 hours in the water
Small groups, max 8 per instructor
Surfboard and wet shirt or wetsuit included
trips.departsFrom: Pick up points: Noosa North Shore Ferries (Tewantin), The J Noosa (60 Noosa Drive, Noosa Heads), Noosa Heads Bus Station, 12 Robert St Noosaville (Coral Beach Resort), or Noosa North Shore accommodation
includes: Surf guide and small group instruction
trips.requirements: Suitable for complete beginners. Children under 8 in a group lesson need a parent or guardian to assist in the water.
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site; the page says to start a booking to see it, so prices are only in the Rezdy widget. Max 8 participants per instructor comes from the FAQ page. The page says "We guarantee you'll stand up on your first lesson" and calls itself the only surf school in Noosa with lessons on a point break; not used as standouts.

trips.title: Private Surf Lessons Noosa
trips.summary: One-on-one surf coaching at Double Island Point, with the 4x4 beach drive from Noosa shared with the day's other guests. The long point break gives more time on each wave to work on pop-ups, timing and board handling. It suits all ages, from kids and beginners to improving surfers.
highlights: Private one-on-one instruction
Shared 4x4 beach drive from Noosa
Wetsuits or wet shirts and surf equipment included
National Park entry fees included
trips.departsFrom: Pick up points in Noosa: The J Noosa Theatre, Noosa Heads Bus Station, Bounce Noosa, Coral Beach Resort Noosa, Noosa North Shore Ferries, Noosa North Shore
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site; the page says to start a booking to see it.

trips.title: Epic Play & Explore, Great Beach Drive 4X4 Adventure (Noosa to Double Island Point)
trips.summary: A 4x4 day trip from Noosa to Double Island Point with free time to swim, surf, paddle or relax. You can ask for a kayak or paddleboard for the lagoon, a surfboard, bodyboard, floating ring or shade cabana, but no lesson is included. Lunch is not provided, so bring food.
highlights: Great Beach Drive past the Rainbow Beach coloured sands
Free time at Honeymoon Bay and the point break
Gear on request: kayak, SUP, surfboards, bodyboard, Coolcabana
Bring your own surfboard at no extra cost
trips.departsFrom: Pick up points in Noosa: The J Noosa Theatre, Noosa Heads Bus Station, Bounce Noosa, Coral Beach Resort Noosa, Noosa North Shore Ferries, Noosa North Shore
includes: Beach gear and equipment on request
bring: Own surfboard and wetsuit if wanted
trips.requirements: For surfing, best suited to beginner to intermediate surfers who can catch waves on their own. No surf or SUP lesson included. Meet 15 minutes before departure.
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site; the page says to start a booking to see it. Departs daily, times vary with the tide. Damage beyond normal wear may incur repair or replacement costs.

trips.title: Team Building Activities in Noosa
trips.summary: Corporate team days run either on Noosa Main Beach, in the Noosa Heads waterways, or as a full day at Double Island Point. Groups can mix kayaking, paddleboarding, surfing, beach games and SUP yoga, with catering on request. Each program is planned with the team and booked by enquiry.
highlights: Noosa Main Beach sessions, 2-4 hours, up to 150+ people
Double Island Point day, 5-7 hours, up to 84 people
Noosa Heads waterways, 2-3 hours, up to 72 people
Noosa Heads SUP Yoga, 2 hours, up to 40 people
trips.departsFrom: Walking distance or custom pick up from Noosa accommodation
trips.checkNotes: Enquiry only (Contact Us buttons), no price and no booking link. Contact on the page: suzie@epicoceanadventures.com.au, (07) 5372 8066. The FAQ on this page describes only two options while the top of the page lists four.

trips.title: School Groups
trips.summary: Outdoor education programs for schools at Double Island Point or in the Noosa Heads waterways. Lessons can cover geography, marine biology, history and Indigenous studies and outdoor education, adjusted to year level. Programs are tailored and booked by enquiry.
highlights: Two locations: Double Island Point or Noosa Heads waterways
Curriculum links to Geography, Science, Marine Studies and History
Private guides and private transport
Pick up from schools in Noosa
trips.departsFrom: Pick up from schools in Noosa or Noosa North Shore Ferries
trips.checkNotes: Enquiry only, no price and no booking link.
